summary.text: Brenda Dietrich is a Republican who represents Kansas Senate District 20 in Shawnee County and has served in the Senate since 2021, after serving in the Kansas House from 2017 to 2020.
She chairs the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her Kansas Legislature profile, Dietrich is a retired superintendent.

She also chairs the Joint Committee on Fiduciary Financial Institutions Oversight, the Joint Committee on Pensions, Investments and Benefits, and the Joint Committee on Special Claims Against the State.
She is a member of the Commerce, Federal and State Affairs, and Transportation committees and the Senate Select Committee on Veterans Affairs.
